subject: 1.  MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO BE ALERT TO UNUSUAL, ABNORMAL OR HOSTILE ACTIVITIES BY PIRATES
text:
1.  MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO BE ALERT TO UNUSUAL, ABNORMAL OR HOSTILE ACTIVITIES BY PIRATES
(ESPECIALLY DURING DARKENED HOURS) IN THE APPROACHES TO AND IN BUENAVENTURA
HARBOR/ANCHORAGE.
2.  TWO U.S. FLAG VESSELS HAVE RECENTLY BEEN FIRED UPON, RESULTING IN PERSONAL INJURIES.
